title: Structured Persona Training
definition: The practice of structuring training data for AI models to facilitate the development of well-defined, consistent, and accurate personas.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Teaching AI models to act like specific characters by structuring data so they learn the character's unique personality traits, voice, and behavior patterns.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Organizing training data for AI models in a structured format to develop accurate and consistent personas through the use of controlled dimensions like occupation, motivation, personality traits, skills, and emotional and topic labels.
difficulty_levels.expert: A method for improving the quality and realism of AI personas by structuring training data around specific dimensions (e.g., occupation, motivation, personality traits, skills) and incorporating emotional and topic labels to help models develop well-defined, coherent, and believable characters.

extra_fields.insight: Structured training data is essential for creating realistic AI personas.
